english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something lavish or luxurious, especially its appearance, facilities, or style.
This is the all-purpose choice for something luxurious, especially a hotel, room, or vehicle.
Use this when the emphasis is on conspicuous luxury or lavishness rather than general style.
Choose this when rich means luxurious, sumptuous, or made with costly materials.
